correctness.rationale: For all positive vectors, the third positive facet coefficientwise dominates two-thirds of every facet. Hence every positive unit pair has normed sum >= 4/3. The original pair attains it. Equality of the supporting facet sum forces both vectors onto the two explicit edge faces; same-face pairs have normed sum 2, and opposite faces have sum-facet values 2-b, 2-a, 4/3, 5(a+b)/6. Their simultaneous <=4/3 condition is precisely the stated triangular domain. Exact rational program verifies all coefficient and vertex identities.
